Offering Summary

A design-approved, permit-submitted townhome project in Westgate

Adam Cobb of Windermere Real Estate is pleased to exclusively present the opportunity to acquire Cascara Townhomes, a six-townhome development project at 9516 Edmonds Way (SR 104) in Edmonds, Washington: two three-story buildings of three homes, set on either side of a central drive aisle and joined overhead by a black-framed trellis.

The CODA Architecture design provides 10,278 net square feet across six 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath homes of roughly 1,650–1,800 net SF, each with a private two-car garage (12 stalls provided, 11 required). The street-facing homes add glass-railed rooftop terraces.

The 11,571 SF (0.27-acre) RM-EW parcel sits on the south side of Edmonds Way in the Westgate area, a few blocks east of the Westgate commercial node. The design received Architectural Design Board approval in December 2024, and the building-permit application was submitted in May 2025.

      Edmonds & Westgate

      Minutes from the ferry, the waterfront and downtown Edmonds

      WESTGATE is on the city's west side, centered on 100th Avenue West and Edmonds Way (SR 104), with a busy commercial corridor and new mixed-use development. The Westgate Shopping District is about 0.3 mi from the site. The surrounding neighborhood is primarily single-family homes from the 1950s and 1960s.

      EDMONDS sits on Puget Sound at the south end of Snohomish County. The Edmonds–Kingston ferry crosses in about 30 minutes, Edmonds Station offers Sounder commuter rail, and Community Transit's Swift Blue and Orange lines connect to Link light rail at Shoreline North and Lynnwood City Center.
